process.title: code39.py — Code 39 校验字符（mod 43）
process.scope: Owns code39.py and tests/test_code39.py only. Implements code39_checksum/code39_encode/code39_verify and their tests. Does not touch numwords, solids, or any existing file.
process.task:
Create code39.py and tests/test_code39.py (new files only; do not modify any existing file). Standard library only; do not import the other modules.

Spec:
- Character set and values pinned (43 characters total, value = index): `0123456789ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ-. $/+%` — digits 0-9 have values 0-9, uppercase letters A-Z have values 10-35, and `-`, `.`, space, `$`, `/`, `+`, `%` have values 36-42 in that order.
- code39_checksum(text: str) -> str: sum the character values, mod 43, return the character at that value. Non-str raises TypeError; empty string raises ValueError; characters outside the set (lowercase letters, `!`, etc.) raise ValueError.
- code39_encode(text: str) -> str: returns "*" + text + checksum char + "*"; checksum and exceptions same as code39_checksum.
- code39_verify(symbol: str) -> bool: non-str raises TypeError; returns True iff symbol starts with `*`, ends with `*`, total length >= 4, all inner characters are in the set, and the last inner character equals the checksum of the remaining inner part; otherwise returns False (never raises for other cases).

Acceptance items (each needs a test case):
- code39_checksum("A") == "A"
- code39_checksum("CODE39") == "W"
- code39_checksum("HELLO") == "B"
- code39_checksum("123") == "6"
- code39_checksum("Z") == "Z"
- code39_checksum("%") == "%"
- code39_checksum(" ") == " "
- code39_encode("CODE39") == "*CODE39W*"
- code39_encode("A") == "*AA*"
- code39_encode("123") == "*1236*"
- code39_verify("*CODE39W*") is True
- code39_verify("*CODE39X*") is False
- code39_verify("CODE39W") is False
- code39_verify("*AA*") is True
- code39_verify("*A*") is False
- code39_verify("*1236*") is True
- code39_verify("") is False
- code39_verify("**") is False
- code39_verify("*code39W*") is False
- round trip: code39_verify(code39_encode(t)) is True for t in "CODE39", "HELLO", "A", "123", "TEST-1"
- code39_checksum(""), code39_checksum("abc"), code39_checksum("HELLO!"), code39_encode("") raise ValueError
- code39_checksum(123), code39_verify(123) raise TypeError

Every acceptance example/value above must have a corresponding test case. checks (verbatim): python3 -m pytest tests/test_code39.py -q ; python3 -m pytest tests/ -q
